title: Install input-trust runtime for adopters
outOfScope: External provider writes, source-project pushes, or provider configuration changes.
Changing input-trust policy semantics or weakening existing policy tests.
Editing the paused real-adopter-reference-validation Work Item or its evidence.

acceptance: The installer catalog distributes scripts/ai_input_trust.py to new and upgraded adopters.
A regression installs into an isolated non-template repository and imports the installed module to block a representative external instruction request.
The regression proves no source-project or provider remote is contacted and no input-trust decision semantics are changed.

guidelines: Preserve existing input-trust policy semantics; this Work Item changes distribution only.
Use isolated local adopter repositories for installation regressions.
Fail closed if the installed module cannot be imported or fails to block an external instruction probe.

intent.problem: WI-07 real-adopter execution found that scripts/ai_input_trust.py is absent from the installer catalog, so an installed adopter cannot run the template's declared injection boundary.
constraints: Do not change ai_input_trust.py behavior or external-provider state.
Prove the module exists and behaves correctly after an isolated adopter installation.
Keep the paused WI-07 branch and its evidence intact until this corrective Work Item closes.
